title: Logic Remote state messages, as Logic sends them (decoded argument values)
description: The state messages that Logic sends to a Logic Remote peer, after the frame, the optional MAZP layer and the keyed-archive layer are removed (SA-REMOTE-STATE-001). STATIC ANALYSIS ONLY: derived from decompiled code, not checked against real traffic. A property is optional because a receiver may see only some of them at a time; a key that did not arrive is UNKNOWN, never 0 or false. Number-keyed dictionaries (in /gtFaderData) are written here with decimal-string keys because JSON has no number keys; on the wire they are NSNumber keys of a keyed archive. 'NSData' values are written as base64 strings. Facts that JSON Schema cannot express are given as x-notes (for example: all 13 arrays of /ati have the same length).

nsdata.description: NSData. Binary on the wire; base64 only in this JSON rendering.

ati.description: Parallel arrays: element i of every array describes the same strip. Written by the block FUN_01696ebc (0x01696ebc) inside sendChannelStripInfo: (0x0168d478); sent by setAllTrackInfo: (0x016867b4) over TCP, only when it differs from the previous dictionary.

c.description: Four colours per strip: normal (nc), selected (sc), icon-tint normal (tnc), icon-tint selected (tsc). Each is 4 bytes; the byte order is not confirmed.

n.description: Name and the strip info's identifier. gindex is the same identifier as the keys of /gtFaderData 'g' (confirmed in code, not on the wire).

t.description: Track kind from trackTypeForTrack:seqID:ginst:inSong: (0x01693e90). The range is the set of values that function can return (all return statements seen); the meaning of each value is unresolved.

nc.description: From the key name: number of channels. The value comes from a song-level byte through a 15-entry table (DAT_01d59030), so it may be the same for every strip. Hypothesis.

p.description: From the key name: pan type. One of 0, -5, -1, -4 when the strip allows it, otherwise -1; two further constants appear when there is no song (unresolved). Hypothesis.

tn.description: From the key name: strip number; -1 when numberOfStrip: returns 0.

BgTrackInfoTrackIDKey.description: (folder << 16) | (track & 0xffff). Lifetime of the ID is not confirmed (PLAN-08).

BgTrackInfoTrackUUIDKey.description: UUID string; a short default string if the track has none (content not confirmed).

BgTrackInfoHasArrangeKey.description: From the key name: the track also exists on the arrange side. Hypothesis.

BgTrackInfoArrangeHiddenKey.description: From the key name: hidden in the arrange. Hypothesis.

BgTrackInfoCollapsibleInfoKey.description: Bits 0-7: nesting depth; bit 9: the next row is one level deeper (reads as 'has children'); bits 8 and 10: unknown. Hypothesis, confidence medium.

BgTrackInfoMetaInfoFlagsKey.description: 0 or 1 (bit 5 of a 32-bit value of the 'spu' argument). May be the same for every strip.

x-notes: All 13 arrays have the same length (the block appends one element to each per strip).
The same dictionary can be sent twice during the initial send.

sti.description: The selected track. On the wire the argument is MAZP(NSKeyedArchiver(dictionary)) (compression level 9); this schema describes the dictionary. Sent only when it differs from the previous one (setSelectedTrackInfo: 0x0168df54).

n.description: The track name; 'NoTrackSelected' when nothing is selected.

t.description: One byte (+3) of the selected track's record. A different computation from /ati 't'.

BgTrackInfoIndexKey.description: Strip index from getStrip:forTrackWithID:; NSIntegerMax (9223372036854775807) if not found.

gtFaderData.description: Fader, mute, solo and record-enable state. 'g' is keyed by the strip's identifier (instID = /ati gindex), 't' by the track ID. Either may be absent in one message. With changedMask 0 every field is included; otherwise only the changed ones, so a single entry may carry only some of its fields.

vL.description: Signed 32-bit volume level: (int8 at +0x8b) << 24 unless the strip's own 32-bit value has the same top byte. Hypothesis: fader position. The relation to dB and to the MCU's 14 bits is not confirmed.

s.description: Signed byte at +0x8c. Range not confirmed.

m.description: 0/1 normally, 2/3 under some conditions, +0x80 when a global flag is set. Meaning not confirmed.

r.description: Record-enable kind (the values the code can assign). Present only when the target could be looked up.

ip.description: Up to 12 bits; bit k is a flag of channel k ('independent pan' from the key name).

trackSelectionStates.description: On the wire the argument is NSKeyedArchiver(dictionary), not compressed. From the key names: whether the previous / next track can be selected.

x-examples-note: Synthetic; not captured from a real connection.
